# Packages to exclude from the automated changelog (downloads/CHANGELOG.md).
#
# One entry per line. A plain name ignores the package in every source; prefix
# with a source to limit the match, e.g. "pip:six" or "msys2:ncurses".
# Matching is case-insensitive and '_' equals '-'. '#' starts a comment.
#
# Do not edit this file - add your own entries to local/changelog-ignore.txt
# (one entry per line, same format); both files are merged.
#
# Listed here: pure library/infrastructure packages whose version bumps are
# noise. DFIR-relevant packages (flare-capa, oletools, pefile, capstone,
# sigma-cli, dissect, ...) are deliberately NOT listed so their updates stay
# visible in the changelog.
